diagnostics.message: "disable_sandbox" is on the Chromium deny list: it would disable the sandbox, site isolation or process locks (invariant 1).
"remote_debugging_port" is on the Chromium deny list: remote debugging on a network port or a pipe is not allowed (invariant 7).
"ignore_certificate_errors" is on the Chromium deny list: it would disable web security, certificate checks or CORS (invariants 1 and 6).
"google_api_key" is on the Chromium deny list: Google API keys do not belong in configuration (invariant 9).
"enable_sync" is on the Chromium deny list: it would re-enable sign-in, sync, metrics upload, crash upload or variations fetches (architecture.md section 12).
"auto_grant_permissions" is on the Chromium deny list: it would auto-grant permissions, media capture or extension installs (invariant 6).
"--no-sandbox" is on the Chromium deny list: it would disable the sandbox, site isolation or process locks (invariant 1).
